headline: Portland's AI builders, in one room, once a month
story: Engineers, founders, researchers and the curious meet to show what they're building and learn from each other. Come to one event and you'll leave with two people to follow up with.

recent.title: Hack for Humanity
recent.note: 70+ signed up for a day of building together.

ways_in.title: Come to an event
ways_in.text: Free, and no AI background needed.

ways_in.title: Demo something
ways_in.text: Five minutes, a screen and a mic. Tell us what you're building.

ways_in.title: Host or sponsor
ways_in.text: A room for 60, or food for the night.
